blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Test-time augmentation (TTA) aggregates model predictions across multiple transformed views of an input during inference. Because histology images lack a canonical orientation, $D_4$ TTA---pooling across the 8 rotations and reflections of a square---is a standard default in computational pathology. However, the rise of self-supervised histology foundation models (FMs) with inherent rotational invariance calls its continued utility into question. We benchmark 9 histology FMs and 6 general-purpose models across four patch-level and two whole-slide image (WSI) datasets. We find that $D_4$ TTA remains a reliable post hoc improvement, but benefits diminish from $+1.98$ percentage points (pp) for general-purpose backbones to $+0.50$ pp for histology FMs on TCGA-UT, and shrink further for the largest models. To eliminate computational overhead, our experiments demonstrate that entropy routing---applying TTA selectively to uncertain predictions---recovers most of the gain while augmenting only ${\sim}13\%$ of samples. Finally, we show that patch-level TTA improvements do not transfer to slide-level multiple instance learning (MIL). Code: https://github.com/lars-chen/histology-tta

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Histopathology image analysis increasingly relies on foundation models (FMs): large vision transformers pretrained on millions of hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) tissue patches by self-supervised learning ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Vorontsov et al., 2023 ; Filiot et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Scalbert et al., 2026 ) . The strong downstream performance of FMs has made them the standard feature extractor in computational pathology.
blocks.zh: 组织病理学图像分析越来越依赖于基础模型(FMs):大型视觉变压器通过自我监督的学习预先对数百万异马托基林和eosin(H&E)组织补丁进行训练(Chen等人,2024年;沃龙佐夫等人,2023年;Filiot等人,2023年;许等人,2024年;Scalbert等人,2026年)。 FM的强下游性能使其成为计算病理学的标准特征提取器.

blocks.en: Because tissue patches have no canonical orientation, evaluating all eight dihedral-group views at inference and aggregating predictions is a principled inference-time strategy for enforcing rotational and reflection invariance without retraining. Given recent advances in pretraining scale and objectives, however, whether test-time augmentation (TTA) still yields meaningful gains for FM-based classifiers remains an open question. We provide a systematic evaluation of this strategy across modern FMs commonly deployed in computational pathology pipelines ( Lu et al., 2021 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) . Figure 1 provides a graphical overview of our approach, and Table 2 summarizes the datasets used in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 因为组织补丁没有犬目定向,在推论中评价所有8个二面体-群观,并汇总预测,是一种原则性的推论-时间策略,用于在不进行再培训的情况下强制进行旋转和反射偏移. 然而,鉴于培训前的规模和目标最近有所进展,测试时间的增强是否仍能给基于调频的分类器带来有意义的收益,仍是一个未决问题。 我们对通常部署在计算病理学管道中的现代调频系统评估这项战略(Lu等人,2021年;Gao等人,2025年)。 图1概述了我们的方法,表2概述了我们在试验中使用的数据集。

blocks.en: Tissue patches are approximately symmetric under the dihedral group D 4 D_{4} , i.e., the eight isometries of a square, comprising four rotations (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°) and their respective reflections. An ideal classifier should therefore be invariant to these transforms. This can be achieved in two ways: training-time augmentation applies random D 4 D_{4} transforms during training, encouraging the model to learn invariant representations; instead, TTA averages predictions across all eight views at inference, approximating invariance post hoc without modifying the trained model.
blocks.zh: 组织补丁在二面体组D 4 D_{4}下大致对称,即一个正方形的8个同位素,由4个旋转(0°,90°,180°,270°)及其各自的反射组成. 因此,理想的分类方法不应影响这些转变。 这可以通过两种方式实现:培训时间增强在培训期间随机应用D 4 D_{4}的变换,鼓励模型学习变化无常的表述;相反,TTA推论对所有8种观点的预测平均值,在不修改训练有素的模型的情况下,近似变化无常的后缀.

In practice, however, averaging can correct some predictions while corrupting others. When f f is already G G -invariant, the Reynolds operator reduces to the identity and TTA provides no benefit.

blocks.en: Hence, we investigate to what extent modern histology FMs are D 4 D_{4} invariant, and under what conditions TTA provides meaningful gains. We address this through a large-scale TTA evaluation in computational pathology, spanning: • 16 models from three families: 9 histology-specialized FMs, 6 general-purpose vision models, and 1 D 4 D_{4} -equivariant reference model (Table 1 ) • 4 patch datasets of varying difficulty: TCGA-UT (31 classes) ( Komura et al., 2022 ) , NCT-CRC-HE-100K and NCT-CRC-HE-NoNorm (9 classes each) ( Kather et al., 2019 ) , and MHIST (2 classes) ( Wei et al., 2021 ) • 2 whole-slide image (WSI) datasets for slide-level TTA analysis: Camelyon17 (lymph node sections) ( Bandi et al., 2018 ) , and PANDA (prostate biopsy samples) ( Bulten et al., 2022 ) , covering both patch-level and weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) classification

blocks.en: Our key finding is that D 4 D_{4} TTA is a reliable, modest post hoc improvement for patch classification, even with strong histology FMs. On TCGA-UT, histology FMs gain + 0.5 +0.5 pp in balanced accuracy on average, while general-purpose backbones benefit + 2 +2 pp. TTA improves predictions over all four patch benchmarks, but the average gains are smaller in higher baseline tasks (see Figure 2 and Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的关键发现是D4 DQQ4} TTA是对补丁分类的可靠,适度的后期改进,即使具有强的神学调频. 在TCGA-UT上,神学调频平均在平衡准确度上得到+ 0.5+ 0.5pp,而通用主干线有利于+ 2+2pp. TTA改进了对所有四个补丁基准的预测,但在更高的基线任务中平均收益较小(见图2和表5).

blocks.en: At inference time, the full G = D 4 G=D_{4} TTA increases the computational cost by a factor of | G | = 8 |G|=8 . For histology FMs, where the average gain is small, this cost could be hard to justify in routine clinical or research use. By contrast, general-purpose backbones exhibit greater view-to-view disagreement and weaker class separability, so TTA yields larger average improvements and can be worthwhile. We therefore evaluate entropy-based selective TTA ( Son and Kang, 2023 ) to determine how much overhead can be avoided while retaining most of the performance benefit across models with different baseline degrees of rotational invariance.
blocks.zh: 推论时,全G=D 4 G=D_{4}TTA将计算成本增加一个系数 Q=8 |G|=8. 对于平均收益很小的神学调频器来说,这种成本在常规的临床或研究使用中可能很难证明合理. 相比之下,通用骨干表现出更大的观景分歧和较弱的类分离性,因此TTA产生更大的平均改进,可以值得. 因此,我们评价基于肽的选择性TTA(Son and Kang, 2023年),以确定可以避免多少间接费用,同时保留不同基线旋转偏移度的模型的大部分性能效益。

blocks.en: Finally, we extend the analysis beyond independent tiles to WSIs. Because these gigapixel-scale clinical slides require aggregating thousands of patches via MIL, we test whether localized tile-level corrections survive this process to improve overall slide-level performance.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们把分析范围扩大到了独立的瓦片以外的瓦片。 由于这些千兆像素尺度的临床幻灯片需要通过MIL聚合数千个补丁,我们测试局部的瓦片级校正是否在这一过程中存活下来,以提高整体的幻灯片级性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Test-Time Augmentation
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 试验时间延长

blocks.en: TTA has a long history in computer vision, from early ensemble methods ( Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ) to systematic studies of augmentation policies and aggregation ( Shanmugam et al., 2021 ; Kim et al., 2020 ) . In biomedical imaging, it is routinely applied in histopathology ( Liu et al., 2017 ) , microscopy cell segmentation ( Moshkov et al., 2020 ) , and dermatology ( Perez et al., 2018 ) . Most prior work studies whether TTA helps a particular model on a particular task, without systematically evaluating how its benefit varies across modern backbone families (notably transformer-based models) or across different classifier heads and pretraining strategies.
blocks.zh: TTA在计算机视觉方面有着悠久的历史,从早期综艺方法(Krizhevsky等人,2012年)到系统研究增强政策和聚合(Shanmugam等人,2021年;Kim等人,2020年). 在生物医学成像中,常规应用在组织病理学(刘等人,2017年),显微镜细胞分解(莫什科夫等人,2020年),皮肤学(佩雷斯等人,2018年)中. 大多数以前的工作研究是TTA帮助特定模式完成某项任务,而没有系统地评价其好处如何在现代骨干家庭(特别是基于变压器的模型)之间,还是在不同的分类头和预培训策略之间发生差异。

blocks.en: Elesedy and Zaidi (2021) prove that averaging a predictor over a symmetry group strictly improves generalization when the target is invariant. Beyond computer vision, Foit et al. (2025) recently demonstrated the efficacy of group-averaged TTA for autoregressive prediction in physics.
blocks.zh: Elesedy和Zaidi(2021年)证明,当目标变异时,平均预测器超过对称组会严格改善概括性. 除了计算机视觉之外,Foit等人(2025年)最近展示了群体平均TTA在物理学中自动回转预测的功效.

blocks.en: Shanmugam et al. (2021) find that TTA, while improving accuracy overall, also turns some correct predictions into incorrect ones, and that learned aggregation outperforms simple averaging. TTA also multiplies inference cost, so Son and Kang (2023) propose selective TTA that routes uncertain samples to additional augmentations. However, it remains unclear how D 4 D_{4} TTA and selective routing behave across modern histology FMs versus general-purpose backbones.
blocks.zh: Shanmugam等人(2021年)发现,TTA在整体提高准确性的同时,也将一些正确的预测转化为不正确的预测,而所学的汇总性能也简单地超过了平均. TTA也乘以推论成本,所以Son和Kang(2023年)提出选择性的TTA,将不确定的样本引向额外的增强. 然而,D 4 D_{4}TTA和有选择的路由在现代神学调频与通用主干之间如何表现仍然不清楚。

blocks.en: 2.2 Foundation Models for Histopathology
blocks.zh: 2.2 组织病理学基础模型

blocks.en: The past two years have seen an explosion of histology FMs pretrained by self-supervised learning on large histopathology corpora (Table 1 ): CTransPath ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , Phikon ( Filiot et al., 2023 ) and Phikon-v2 ( Filiot et al., 2024 ) , UNI ( Chen et al., 2024 ) and UNI-v2, Virchow ( Vorontsov et al., 2023 ) and Virchow-v2 ( Zimmermann et al., 2024 ) , GigaPath ( Xu et al., 2024 ) and H-Optimus-1 ( Scalbert et al., 2026 ) . They range from 28M to 1.1B parameters and from tens of millions to billions of training tiles, and most are pretrained with DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) ; Phikon uses iBOT ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) and CTransPath a contrastive objective.
blocks.zh: 在过去两年中,经过自我监督的关于大型组织病理科的学习而预先培养出来的组织病理调频(表1):CtransPath(Wang等人,2022年),Phikon (Filiot等人,2023年)和Phikon-v2(Filiot等人,2024年),UNI(Chen等人,2024年)和UNI-v2,Virchow(Worix等人,2023年)和Virchow-v2(Zimmermann等人,2024年),Gigapath(Xu等人,2024年)和H-Optimus-1(Scalbert等人,2026年). 它们从28M到1.1B参数,从数千万到数十亿的训练瓷砖,大多数都使用DINOv2进行预训(Oquab等人,2023年);Phikon使用iBOT(周等人,2022年)和CTransPath作为对比目标.

blocks.en: A common feature of these models’ pretraining is strong stochastic augmentation, including geometric ones such as crops, flips and rotations, used within self-supervised learning objectives such as DINO and iBOT ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ) . By explicitly matching model outputs across differently augmented views of the same patch ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ) , these objectives encourage invariance to the augmentation set, promoting D 4 D_{4} -stable representations when D 4 D_{4} transforms are included. Along with the orientation diversity of histopathology data, these objectives would be expected to yield approximately D 4 D_{4} -invariant representations. We find instead that histology FM embeddings are about as D 4 D_{4} -invariant as those of general-purpose models (Section 4.6 ); their prediction stability arises from classification margin.
blocks.zh: 这些模型的预训的一个共同特点是强烈的拓扑增强,包括作物,翻转和旋转等几何拓扑,在DINO和iBOT等自我监督的学习目标中使用(Caron等人,2021年;Oquab等人,2023年;Zhou等人,2022年). 通过明确匹配模型输出不同程度地增强同一补丁(Caron等人,2021年;Zhou等人,2022年)的观点,这些目标鼓励了对扩增套件的偏差,促进D 4 D_{4} - 包括D 4 D_{4}变换时的平稳表示. 除了组织病理学数据的方向多样性之外,预计这些目标将产生大约D 4 D_{4} - 变化无常的表述。 相反,我们发现,组织FM嵌入法与通用模型(第4.6节)的嵌入法相近,为D 4 D_{4}-变化无常;其预测稳定性来自分类比值。

blocks.en: In addition to histology-specialized FMs, computational pathology pipelines frequently rely on general-purpose FMs (e.g., ImageNet-pretrained CNNs and self-supervised transformers such as DINOv2) as tile encoders and baselines due to their accessibility and strong performance ( Lu et al., 2021 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Oquab et al., 2023 ) . Because these models are not trained on histology with the same orientation diversity as histology FMs, they provide a useful contrast case in our study.
blocks.zh: 除了神学专业调频外,计算病理管道还经常依靠通用调频(如ImageNet预装的CNN和DINov2等自控变压器)作为瓷砖编码器和基准,因为它们的可访问性和强性能(Lu等人,2021年;Gao等人,2025年;Oquab等人,2023年). 由于这些模型没有接受过与神学调频相同的定向多样性的神学训练,它们为我们的研究提供了一个有用的对比案例.

blocks.en: 2.3 Equivariant Neural Networks
blocks.zh: 2.3 等效神经网络

blocks.en: Group-equivariant convolutional networks ( Cohen and Welling, 2016 ; Weiler and Cesa, 2019 ) provide architectural guarantees of equivariance to specified symmetry groups. For the D 4 D_{4} group, architectures like E2-CNNs ( Weiler and Cesa, 2019 ) and p ​ 4 ​ m p4m -CNNs ( Cohen and Welling, 2016 ) ensure that feature maps transform predictably under rotations and reflections. Rotation-equivariant architectures have shown benefits in microscopy and histopathology ( Chidester et al., 2019 ; Veeling et al., 2018 ; Lafarge et al., 2021 ) . We construct D4WRN, a Wide ResNet with a D 4 D_{4} -equivariant backbone and an invariant readout, as a reference point: its predictions are D 4 D_{4} -invariant by construction, so its TTA benefit should be near zero.
blocks.zh: 集团-等价革命网络(Cohen and Welling, 2016;Weiler and Cesa, 2019)为特定对称团体提供等价的建筑保障. 对于D 4 D_{4}组,像E2-CNNs(Weiler and Cesa, 2019)和p 4 m p4m - CNNs(Cohen and Welling, 2016)这样的建筑确保地物图在旋转和反射下可以预测的转变. 旋转-等效建筑在显微镜学和组织病理学中表现出了优势(Chidester等人,2019年;Veeling等人,2018年;Lafarge等人,2021年). 我们建造了D4WRN,一个宽的ResNet,有一个D 4 D_{4}-等宽的骨干和无变的读取,作为参考点:它的预测值是D 4 D_{4}-通过建筑不变,所以它的TTA的好处应该接近于零.

blocks.en: Prior work establishes TTA as a generally useful ensembling technique and motivates D 4 D_{4} symmetry for histology. Elphick et al. (2025) found that FMs pretrained with rotation augmentation have tighter rotation orbits in embedding space, but did not examine downstream predictions or TTA. We show that orbit size barely predicts whether a prediction changes under D 4 D_{4} ; what matters is the relative distance to the decision boundary (Section 4.6 ).

blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 模式

blocks.en: We evaluate 16 models spanning three categories (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价16种模式,分为三类(表1)。

blocks.en: Histology foundation models (9 models) are used with frozen backbones and a trained linear classification head, following the standard linear probing protocol. This isolates the quality of the pretrained representations without confounding from downstream finetuning.
blocks.zh: 历史基础模型(9种模型)采用冷冻骨干和一个经过训练的线性分类头,遵循标准线性探测协议. 这隔离了事先经过训练的表述的质量,而不会与下游的微调相混淆.

blocks.en: General-purpose models (6 models) pretrained on ImageNet are evaluated in both frozen (linear probe) and finetuned configurations to assess how downstream adaptation affects TTA benefit.
blocks.zh: 在ImageNet上预先培训的通用模型(6种模型)在冷冻(线性探测器)和微调配置中都得到评价,以评估下游适应如何影响TTA的好处。

blocks.en: Equivariant reference (1 model): a D 4 D_{4} -equivariant Wide ResNet, D4WRN ( Zagoruyko and Komodakis, 2016 ; Weiler and Cesa, 2019 ) trained from scratch, providing an architecture with exact D 4 D_{4} -equivariance guarantees.
blocks.zh: 等价参考(1种型号):一种D 4 D_{4} -等价参考 Wide ResNet, D4WRN (Zagoruyko and Komodakis, 2016; Weiler and Cesa, 2019) 从零开始训练,提供精确的D4 D_{4}-等价担保的建筑.

blocks.en: 3.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate on four tile-level classification datasets using the standard splits, summarized in Table 2 : TCGA-UT is split by patient, MHIST uses the provided patient-disjoint split, and both NCT-CRC-HE variants use the standard split with a fixed test set across runs. For the frozen-backbone heads, hyperparameters are selected by 3-fold stratified cross-validation on the training set, with folds fixed across seeds; three folds keep selection tractable at this scale, and all datasets except MHIST leave tens of thousands of tiles per validation fold. Early stopping uses a separate 10% validation split carved from the training data; the test split is never used during training.
blocks.zh: 我们利用标准分数对四个瓦级分类数据集进行评估,汇总于表2:TCGA-UT按病人进行分数,MIST使用提供的病人-离子分数,NCT-CRC-HE两个变体都使用标准分数,并使用固定测试集横行. 对于冰冻的背骨头,超参数在训练集上通过3倍的分层交叉验证来选择,折叠固定在种子上方;三折可以使选择在这个尺度上可拉动,除MHIST以外的所有数据集每个验证折叠都会留下数万块瓦片. 早期停止使用从训练数据中刻出的单独的10%验证分法;在训练中从未使用测试分法.

blocks.en: TCGA-UT ( Komura et al., 2022 ) is the most challenging benchmark with 31 fine-grained tissue classes across multiple organs. NCT-CRC-HE-100K ( Kather et al., 2019 ) and its non-normalized variant isolate the impact of stain normalization versus geometric TTA. MHIST ( Wei et al., 2021 ) is a clinically challenging binary task requiring the differentiation of benign Hyperplastic Polyps (HP) from precancerous Sessile Serrated Adenomas/Polyps (SSA).
blocks.zh: TCGA-UT(Komura等人,2022年)是最具挑战性的基准,跨多个器官有31个细纹组织类. NCT-CRC-HE-100K(Kather等人,2019年)及其非正常化变体隔离了污点正常化对几何TTA的影响. MHIST(Wei等人,2021年)是一项临床上具有挑战性的二进制任务,要求将良性超塑性多肽(HP)与先天性塞西里德·阿登诺马斯(英语:Sessile Serred Adenomas/Polyps (SSA))区分开来.

blocks.en: 3.5 Training Protocol

blocks.en: We pre-extract patch embeddings once from each frozen backbone and train lightweight heads on top of the fixed features. Our primary head is a linear probe : a single fully-connected layer trained by stochastic gradient descent (Adam) with cross-entropy loss, following the standard self-supervised linear-probe protocol ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) . We additionally report one- and two-hidden-layer MLP probes and k k -nearest-neighbor baselines ( k ∈ { 5 , 10 } k\in\{5,10\} ). For the linear and MLP heads, the learning rate ( { 10 − 3 , 3 × 10 − 4 } \{10^{-3},\,3\times 10^{-4}\} ) and weight decay ( { 10 − 4 , 10 − 3 } \{10^{-4},\,10^{-3}\} ) are selected via 3-fold cross-validation on the training set; the head is then trained on the full training set for up to 30 epochs with early stopping (patience 3) on a held-out 10% validation split, with batch size 512. Hyperparameters are selected once per (model, dataset, head) and shared across seeds.

blocks.zh: 3.6 执行情况

blocks.en: Repository identifiers, pinned revisions, access conditions and references for all pretrained backbones are listed in Table 7 . D4WRN was constructed using the escnn library ( Cesa et al., 2022 ; Weiler and Cesa, 2019 ) as a Wide ResNet-28-6 with steerable convolutions over the dihedral group D 4 D_{4} , yielding 12 12 M parameters, comparable to ResNet-18—the weakest model. Feature maps use regular field types throughout, aggregating in the final stage to produce D 4 D_{4} -invariant embeddings. blocks.en: 4.1 TTA Consistently Improves Predictions
blocks.zh: 4.1 图塔 不断改进预测

blocks.en: Across the 15 frozen-backbone models and 4 datasets, D 4 D_{4} TTA improves balanced accuracy in 50 of 60 model-dataset configurations, indicating that group-averaging is a reliable, but modest, post hoc gain (binomial test vs. 50%: p < 10 − 6 p<10^{-6} ). Improvements are larger for general-purpose backbones than for histology FMs (Figure 2 ). We also observe a clear trend in D 4 D_{4} prediction stability : models with smaller Δ TTA \Delta_{\text{TTA}} tend to show lower view-induced flip rates (Figure 3 (a)).

The full per-model, per-dataset breakdown is reported in Table 5 . Decomposing each Δ TTA \Delta_{\text{TTA}} into the patches TTA corrects versus corrupts (Figure 3 (a)), histology FMs show both fewer corrections and a lower net correction rate than general-purpose backbones.

The nine losses are small, averaging − 0.21 -0.21 pp against + 0.47 +0.47 pp for the gains, and concentrate on MHIST, the smallest test set; none occurs on TCGA-UT. Across all models and datasets, TTA corrects 1.6 predictions for every one it corrupts, and every model corrects more than it corrupts (Figure 3 (a)), even where its net gain is small.

blocks.en: These conclusions are robust to the choice of lightweight classifier head on top of frozen features (linear vs. MLP vs. k k NN), with head-family averages summarized in Table 6 . They are likewise robust to pretraining-corpus overlap: excluding the three histology FMs whose pretraining corpora include TCGA slides (Table 1 ) widens the gap on TCGA-UT from 3.9 × 3.9\times to 4.7 × 4.7\times , and the gap replicates on the three patch datasets with no TCGA content.
blocks.zh: 这些结论对于在冷冻特性之上选择轻量级分类器头(线性对MLP对k k NN)来说是有力的,头-家平均值见表6。 同样,它们也与培训前-公司重叠:不包括培训前-公司包括TCGA幻灯片的三种神学调频(表1),这扩大了TCGA-UT上的差距,从3.9×3.9\时扩大到4.7×4.7\时,在没有TCGA内容的3个补丁数据集上出现差距。

blocks.en: We test whether the decline in TTA benefit for stronger models is simply due to reduced error (less “headroom”) by measuring the net correction rate per dataset. On TCGA-UT, the corrected-to-corrupted ratio becomes less favorable as model quality increases (roughly from ∼ 2 : 1 \sim\!2{:}1 for the weakest backbones to ∼ 1.3 : 1 \sim\!1.3{:}1 for the strongest FMs), suggesting that the remaining mistakes of stronger models are less often fixable by simple geometric averaging.
blocks.zh: 我们通过衡量每套数据的净校正率来检验TTA对更强模型的好处的下降是否仅仅是由于减少了错误(小于“前厅”). TCGA-UT上,由于模型质量的提升,校正对折合比率变得不那么有利(大致从∼2:1\sim\!2{:}最弱骨干到∼1.3:1\sim\!1.3{}1最强调频),说明较强的模型的剩余错误通过简单的几何平均可以修复的频率较少.

blocks.en: The remaining gains concentrate among high-entropy predictions (Figure 3 (b–c)), a pattern we explain in Section 4.6 . Table 5 reports the per-model results for all datasets; on TCGA-UT, general-purpose backbones tend to benefit the most, whereas histology FMs, especially the largest ones, show consistently smaller improvements.
blocks.zh: 剩余的收益集中在高强度预测(图3(b-c))中,我们在第4.6节中解释了这一模式。 表5报告所有数据集的按模型计算的结果;关于TCGA-UT,通用主干线往往受益最大,而组织调频,特别是最大的调频,则显示改进程度一直较小。

blocks.en: The D4WRN, exactly D 4 D_{4} -equivariant by construction, shows no TTA benefit on average ( + 0.00 +0.00 pp over all four datasets, within ± 0.2 \pm 0.2 pp on each; Table 5 ), despite being much smaller ( ∼ 12 {\sim}12 M parameters) and having no large-scale pretraining. We treat it as an informative but uncontrolled reference, since it differs from histology FMs in architecture (Wide ResNet vs. ViT), scale (86M–1.1B parameters), and training protocol.
blocks.zh: D4WRN,准确的D 4 D_{4}-按构造均匀,平均显示没有TTA的好处(所有四个数据集的+ 0.00+ 0.00 pp,每个数据集在± 0.2\pm 0.2 pp;表5),尽管要小得多(∼ 12 {\sim}12 M参数)并且没有大规模预训. 我们把它当作一个信息性但不受控制的参考,因为它在建筑(Wide ResNet vs.VIT),尺度(86M-1.1B参数)和培训协议方面与神学调频不同.

blocks.en: 4.2 Frozen Backbones Benefit More Than Finetuned
blocks.zh: 4.2 冻结背骨 更多受益 比微调

blocks.en: We evaluate the six general-purpose backbones in both frozen (linear-probe) and finetuned (end-to-end) configurations across all four datasets. Frozen backbones derive a significantly larger benefit from D 4 D_{4} TTA, gaining + 1.28 +1.28 pp versus + 0.80 +0.80 pp when finetuned—a 1.6 × 1.6\times reduction in TTA utility. Importantly, finetuning simultaneously raises the mean baseline balanced accuracy from 71.5 % 71.5\% to 79.9 % 79.9\% ( + 8.4 +8.4 pp), meaning this shrinking TTA benefit accompanies a much stronger base model overall.
blocks.zh: 我们评价所有四个数据集中冷冻(线性探测)和微调(端对端)配置的六个通用骨干。 冷冻骨干从D4 DQQQ4}TTA得到的效益要大得多,在微调时得到+1.28+1.28 pp,相对于+0.80+0.80 pp——TTA的功用减少1.6×1.6\x. 重要的是,同时微调将平均基准平衡精度从71.5% 71.5%提高到79.9% 79.9%(+ 8.4+8.4页),这意味着这种不断缩减的TTA对总体基础模型有利。

blocks.en: The reduction varies by dataset: it is largest on the two large, stain-normalized training sets (TCGA-UT 2.5 × 2.5\times , NCT-CRC-HE-100K 2.3 × 2.3\times ), weaker on NCT-CRC-HE-NoNorm ( 1.3 × 1.3\times ), where stain rather than geometric variation dominates the error (Section 4.8 ), and absent on MHIST ( 1.0 × 1.0\times ), whose 2,175 2{,}175 training patches are too few to instill invariance. Finetuning with augmentation thus absorbs part of the TTA benefit only when training data are sufficient and geometric variation limits accuracy. We conjecture that the same mechanism underlies the small gains of the histology FMs, pretrained with geometric augmentation at far larger scale, but do not test this directly (Section 6.3 ).
blocks.zh: 降幅因数据集而异:在两套大型的污渍正常化培训中(TCGA-UT 2.5×2.5\times,NCT-CRC-HE-100K 2.3×2.3\times),减幅最大,在NCT-CRC-HE-Noorm(1.3×1.3\times)上,污渍而不是几何变化在错误中占主导地位(第4.8节),在MHIST(1.0×1.0\times)上缺席,其2,175个2{}175个培训补丁太少,无法坚持变化。 因此,只有在培训数据充足而且几何变化限制了准确性的情况下,才能通过加固进行精细调整,从而吸收部分TTA的好处。 我们推测,同一机制是史学调频器的微小收益的基础,这种调频器预先经过了更大规模的几何增殖,但并不直接检验这一点(第6.3节)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Strategy Progression: Diminishing Returns Beyond Flips
blocks.zh: 4.3 战略进展:超越翻转的回报减少

blocks.en: Doubling the views from V 4 V_{4} to D 4 D_{4} adds little: most of the gain comes from flips alone, especially for histology FMs, for which the proper rotations add almost nothing (Tables 3 and 5 ). The aggregation method matters little as well: logit-mean and probability-mean averaging are equivalent and confidence weighting is slightly worse, whereas majority voting forfeits about 30% of the gain.
blocks.zh: 将V 4 V_{4}到D 4 D_{4}的观点翻番, 汇总方法也无关紧要:对数-平均值和概率-平均值相等,信心权重略差,而多数投票则丧失约30%的收益。

blocks.en: 4.4 TTA Lowers Predicted Confidence
blocks.zh: 4.4 TTA 降低预期信心

blocks.en: Histology FMs are not better calibrated than general-purpose backbones; on TCGA-UT they are consistently overconfident (ECE 0.058 0.058 vs. 0.011 0.011 ; Figure 5 ). D 4 D_{4} averaging lowers predicted confidence on average, so its effect depends on the starting point: it reduces overconfidence in histology FMs (ECE improves in 26 of 36 model–dataset pairs, Wilcoxon p = 0.02 p=0.02 ), but pushes already well-calibrated general-purpose backbones into underconfidence about as often as it improves them. Pooled over all models, ECE is unchanged, while the top-label Brier score improves ( p < 10 − 8 p<10^{-8} ), partly reflecting the accuracy gain. TTA thus reduces overconfidence where it is present but does not replace explicit recalibration.
blocks.zh: 历史学 调频的校准不比通用调频主机好;在TCGA-UT上,它们始终是过度自信的(ECE 0.058 0.058 vs.0.011 0.011;图5). D 4 D_{Q_{4}平均预测信任度较低,因此其效果取决于起始点:它降低了对组织调频的过度自信(ECE在36个模型组合对中的26个改进,Wilcoxon p = 0.02 p= 0.02),但将已经相当校准的通用调频主机推向信心不足,因为其改进程度也差不多。 在所有模型上,欧洲经委会保持不变,而最高标签的Brier得分则有所改善(p < 10 - 8 p < 10 >-8}),部分反映了准确度的提高。 因此,在存在这种协定的地方,这种协定会减少过度信心,但不会取代明确的重新调整。

blocks.en: 4.5 Agreement Rate Quantifies Prediction-Level Invariance
blocks.zh: 4.5 协议率量化预测水平变化

blocks.en: Histology FMs achieve a mean base-vs- D 4 D_{4} prediction agreement rate of 97.0% (range 91.8%–99.7%) compared to 91.2% (range 74.3%–97.5%) for general-purpose models; per-dataset values are given in Table 3 . This gap quantifies D 4 D_{4} stability at the prediction level, which, as Section 4.6 shows, is a property of the classifier’s decision geometry and is not explained by embedding-space (representation) invariance. Within the FM family the ranking tracks model scale: CTransPath shows the lowest agreement (91.8% on TCGA-UT) while the largest models (Virchow-v2, H-Optimus-1) exceed 98% averaged over datasets.

blocks.en:
Camelyon17 ( Bandi et al., 2018 ) provides 500 H&E-stained lymph-node WSIs from 5 acquisition centers (100 slides, 20 patients per center); 50 slides carry pixel-level lesion polygon annotations.
Tissue patches are 256 × 256 256\times 256 at 20 × 20\times magnification, taken from CLAM segmentation. The frozen UNI patch probe (binary tumor/normal) is evaluated leave-one-patient-out over the 50 annotated slides to avoid leakage. For slide-level MIL we use the standard domain-generalization split: train on centers 0–3 and test on the unseen-scanner center 4 (100 slides).

blocks.en:
PANDA ( Bulten et al., 2022 ) provides prostate biopsy WSIs with pixel-level Gleason-grade annotations.
We binarize annotations into cancer / non-cancer and extract 256 × 256 256\times 256 patches at 20 × 20\times magnification, yielding 10,353 slides with at least one patch ( 3,721 3{,}721 with ≥ 1 \geq 1 cancer patch).

Because patch embeddings are cached for all eight D 4 D_{4} views, slide-level TTA can be applied at two points, which are not equivalent because the aggregator is non-linear: feature-level averages a patch’s eight view embeddings before aggregation, while logit-level runs the trained MIL head once per view and averages the slide logits. We report feature-level results; logit-level gives the same null. The MIL head is gated-attention Attention-based Deep Multiple Instance Learning (ABMIL) ( Ilse et al., 2018 ) (attention dimension 256 256 , classifier hidden dimension 512 512 , dropout 0.25 0.25 ), trained under cross-entropy with Adam (learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 5 10^{-5} ), cosine annealing over 50 epochs and early stopping with patience 15. Heads are trained on single-view features and TTA is applied only at inference, so each comparison isolates test-time averaging on a fixed model.

blocks.en: Adding D 4 D_{4} TTA to a trained ABMIL model ( Ilse et al., 2018 ) does not measurably change bag-level performance. On Camelyon17 this null holds across six backbones spanning weak general-purpose models to strong FMs (ResNet-50, ConvNeXtV2, Phikon-v2, GigaPath, UNI and Virchow-v2). Because TTA is toggled at inference on a fixed trained head, each run forms a paired comparison, which bounds the slide-level effect to within ± 0.003 \pm 0.003 in test AUROC (95% CI, pooled over backbones and seeds). The design detects changes several times smaller than the gains TTA produces at the patch level, so this bounds the effect rather than merely failing to find one. No backbone shows a change surviving correction for six comparisons. On PANDA, ABMIL quadratic-weighted κ \kappa is 0.901 0.901 with TTA versus 0.905 0.905 without, when using the UNI backbone evaluated across 3 cross-validation folds.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Prediction Stability Reflects Joint Backbone–Classifier Geometry
blocks.zh: 6.1 预测稳定性反映联合背骨-分类几何

blocks.en: Embedding invariance is neither necessary nor sufficient for stable predictions. Histology FMs reach 97% D 4 D_{4} agreement with orbits as large as those of general-purpose models, because larger margins keep each orbit on one side of the decision boundary; D4WRN reaches stability the other way, by collapsing its orbits. Two implications follow. First, embedding-level invariance measures such as orbit tightness are a poor guide to whether TTA will help; the margin, or its inexpensive proxy, prediction entropy, is the relevant quantity. Second, because stability depends on the classifier as well as the backbone, TTA benefit is a property of the whole pipeline rather than of the FM alone, consistent with its reduction under finetuning (Section 4.2 ).

blocks.en: 6.2 Practical Recommendations
blocks.zh: 6.2 实际建议

blocks.en: 1. Histology FMs : the + 0.30 +0.30 pp average gain rarely justifies the 8 × 8\times inference cost, so skip TTA by default; stain normalization (Section 4.8 ) is a higher-impact priority. 2. General-purpose backbones : TTA is more worthwhile ( + 1.28 +1.28 pp), especially for frozen linear probes, whose linear head cannot learn invariance from training data ( + 0.80 +0.80 pp when finetuned; Section 4.2 ). 3. High-stakes applications : where small gains matter at scale, TTA may justify its cost, since it corrects more predictions than it corrupts. 4. If TTA is used : average probabilities or logits rather than voting, and apply it selectively (Section 4.7 ); routing patches whose normalized entropy exceeds t ≈ 0.25 t\approx 0.25 augments about one in five FM patches while recovering most of the benefit, and t t can be lowered if the full gain is required. 5. Calibration : for histology FMs, TTA modestly reduces overconfidence; where calibrated probabilities matter, explicit recalibration is cheaper.

blocks.en: 6.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.3 限制

blocks.en: Our study has several limitations. First, training protocol is a confound when comparing histology FMs (frozen linear probes only) to general-purpose models (frozen and finetuned). Finetuning reduces mean TTA gain from + 1.28 +1.28 pp to + 0.80 +0.80 pp, so part of the FM vs. general-purpose gap may reflect downstream adaptation rather than pretraining alone. This reduction is itself dataset-dependent (Section 4.2 ), and we do not test it on histology FMs directly. Second, the D4WRN comparison is uncontrolled (architecture, scale, and training protocol all differ; Section 4.1 ); a matched equivariant control is left to future work. Third, our WSI analysis (Section 5 ) is limited to two datasets with patch-level annotations (Camelyon17, PANDA); generalization to other cancer types and scanners remains to be evaluated. Fourth, our statistical tests (binomial test, Wilcoxon signed-rank, Mann–Whitney/Wilcoxon rank-sum, Spearman correlation with Fisher’s combined p p -value) are each reported without correction for the multiple comparisons made across datasets and models; future work could apply multiple-comparison corrections. Fifth, datasets are limited to H&E staining; immunohistochemistry or other stain types may have different symmetry properties.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有几个局限性。 首先,在将组织FM(只冻线性探测器)与通用模型(冻和微调)进行比较时,训练协议是一个困惑. 微调将TTA的平均值从+1.28+1.28pp降低到+0.80+0.80pp,因此部分FM对普通用途差距可能反映下游适应,而不只是预训. 这种减少本身就取决于数据集(第4.2节),我们不直接通过组织调频进行测试。 第二,D4WRN的比较没有控制(建筑、规模和培训协议都不同;第4.1节);对应的等效控制留给今后的工作。 第三,我们的世界安全倡议分析(第5节)仅限于两个带有补丁级说明的数据集(Camelyon17, PANDA);对其他癌症类型和扫描仪的概括仍有待评估。 第四,我们的统计测试(binomial test, Wilcoxon sign-rank, Mann–Whitney/Wilcoxon squad-sum, Spearman 与 Fisher 综合p-value 的关联) 都未经更正地汇报了对数据集和模型的多重比较; 今后的工作可以应用多重比较的校正. 第五,数据集仅限于H&E染色;免疫史化学或其他染色类型可能具有不同的对称性.

blocks.en: 6.4 Future Directions
blocks.zh: 6.4 未来方向

blocks.en: Our results point to several promising research directions:
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明若干有希望的研究方向:

blocks.en: • Stain-equivariant architectures : Analogous to D 4 D_{4} -equivariant networks for geometric transforms, architectures with built-in stain invariance could address the larger remaining gap. • Adaptive thresholding for selective TTA : We demonstrate entropy-based routing at fixed thresholds (Section 4.7 ); future work could learn per-dataset or per-class thresholds, or jointly optimize the routing policy with the classifier head. • Invariance probing : Developing systematic benchmarks for measuring the degree of learned invariance across different transformation groups (geometric, photometric, stain) would help characterize FM capabilities beyond standard accuracy metrics.
blocks.zh: • 纹理-等效建筑:类似于D 4 D_{4}-等效的几何变换网络,内置污物的建筑可以解决更大的残缺。 • 选择性TTA的适应性阈值: 我们在固定阈值(第4.7节)上演示了基于肽的路由;今后的工作可以学习每个数据集或每个等级的路由阈值,或者与分类器头共同优化路由政策. • 偏差测试:制定系统的基准,以衡量不同变异组别(测地、测光、测污)所学到的偏差程度,将有助于确定调频能力在标准准确度测量标准之外的特点。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We have presented the first large-scale evaluation of TTA across 16 vision models and 4 histopathology datasets. Our results show that modern histology FMs exhibit high prediction stability under D 4 D_{4} transforms and gain only + 0.30 +0.30 pp from D 4 D_{4} TTA, a 4.3 × 4.3\times smaller benefit than general-purpose models. While TTA remains a safe and reliable technique, improving most configurations and correcting more predictions than it corrupts, its marginal benefit for histology FMs suggests that geometric D 4 D_{4} robustness is often not the primary performance bottleneck for tile-level classification with modern FMs.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了对TTA的第一次大规模评估,涉及16个视觉模型和4个组织病理学数据集。 我们的结果显示,现代神学调频在D 4 D QQ 4 } 下表现出高度的预测稳定性,变换并只从D 4 D QQ 4} TTA 得到 + 0.30 + 0.30 pp,一个4.3× 4.3\时的效益比通用模型要小. 虽然TTA仍然是一种安全可靠的技术,改进了大多数配置,纠正了比它腐败的更多的预测,但其对于神话调频的边际好处表明,几何D 4 D_{4}稳健性往往不是与现代调频的瓷砖级分类的主要性能瓶颈.

blocks.en: We further show that entropy-based selective TTA, which routes only uncertain samples to full D 4 D_{4} , recovers over half of the TTA benefit for histology FMs while augmenting only ∼ 13 % {\sim}13\% of patches, providing a practical path to reduced-cost TTA when inference budget is constrained. By contrast, stain normalization has a far larger effect on these models, pointing to stain and scanner robustness as the more pressing open challenge. We release our complete evaluation framework to facilitate further research into invariance properties of histopathology foundation models.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步显示,基于肽的选择性TTA(它只将不确定的样品带到完整的D 4 D_{4}),回收了超过一半的TTA用于组织学调频的好处,同时只增加了13%的补丁,为在推论预算受限制时降低TTTA成本提供了一条切实可行的途径。 相比之下,污点正常化对这些模型的影响要大得多,表明污点和扫描仪的坚固性是更紧迫的公开挑战。 我们发布了完整的评价框架,以促进对组织病理学基础模型的不一致性特性进行进一步研究。
